subject: QBR playbook: account walk-through + forecast reconciliation
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@edgeworks.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR playbook: account walk-through + forecast reconciliation

Team + Priya —

Thanks for committing time this week for the QBR prep. I want to run a focused account-by-account walk-through for our top three deals that materially affect this quarter's OKR for bookings: Acme (enterprise renewal + expansion), EdgeWorks (PO in flight), and BetaCloud (pilot -> expansion). Proposed agenda:

- Quick runway & forecast reconciliation (5–10m per account)
- Critical asks (PO dates, legal/contract needs, support evidence)
- Escalations & proposed mitigations (discount ask, billing credit, SLA notes)
- Owner decisions & next steps

Attachments: consolidated-forecast-03-15-2028.xlsx, QBR-Account-Summaries-Acme-03-2028.pdf — please review the Acme packet before the call (esp. the procurement timeline on p.2).

Priya, can you confirm procurement status and whether your finance team needs a revised invoice template? Michael, please flag any outstanding infra requirements. Internal owners: validate the numbers in the forecast tab and call out any line items you’d like changed.

Goal: lock dollars for the quarter and a short mutual action plan we can share with the execs by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@edgeworks.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR playbook: account walk-through + forecast reconciliation

Sean —

Thanks for the note and the packet. We reviewed the Acme summary this morning. Procurement has a pending PO but it’s held on a legal clause (data retention term) and a billing contact mismatch. I’ve looped in our contracts alias (contracts@acmepartners.com) — they can confirm required language.

Suggested times for the walkthrough: 11:30–12:00pm or 2:30–3:00pm PT tomorrow. We prefer the earlier slot.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a one-page SOC2 evidence checklist during the call? It helps our procurement team speed review.
- If there’s a planned commercial change (discount/credit), we need an updated quote and a DocuSign-ready contract.

On the PO: finance has sign-off pending final language — so the timing is fragile. Happy to join and move this along.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Procurement | Acme Corp
priya.shah@acmecorp.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR playbook: account walk-through + forecast reconciliation

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 09:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Team + Priya —
>
> Thanks for committing time this week for the QBR prep...

Folks — I uploaded the consolidated forecast (sheet: FY28_Q2_forecast). Key callouts:
- Acme: previously forecasted $1.25M; after adjusting for the 60-day procurement lag and a small expansion ARR, I show $960k in committed/near-term (green = PO received or legal ready), $210k at risk (pending PO / terms).
- EdgeWorks: $420k confirmed, small timing variance expected; runway OK.
- BetaCloud pilot: $85k convertible; needs SLA note before committing.

Action items (owners):
- Sean: validate Acme expansion line and confirm whether we pursue a commercial concession to accelerate PO.
- Marissa: attach account brief updates to the Acme packet (esp. contracts timeline).
- Karthik: confirm whether a short-term SLA addendum is feasible for BetaCloud pilot.

Please review the forecast sheet and mark cells with comments by 4:30pm PT. We need a roll-up for leadership by 5pm.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QBR playbook: account walk-through + forecast reconciliation

Aditya / Sean —

Notes from the account brief I attached to the Acme packet:
- Acme (owner: Sean) — HIGH risk: legal is requesting a change to our standard data-retention clause and they want billing to flow to a different cost center. Procurement indicated they can sign this week if we provide: (1) redlined clause acceptable to them, (2) a revised quote noting the cost-center string, and (3) SOC2 checklist.
- EdgeWorks (owner: Michael) — MED risk: Infra provisioning is complete; waiting on internal security review. Timing seems stable for this quarter.
- BetaCloud — LOW risk: pilot metrics look good; need SLA addendum to convert.

Proposed mitigation for Acme: offer a one-time 12% prepay credit on expansion portion only (not renewal), contingent on PO by 3/22 and DocuSign within 72 hours. Financial impact in the consolidated forecast: reduces near-term ARR by ~$30k but preserves quarterly booking OKR.

I’ve attached the redline template and the Acme brief.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 14:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: Acme procurement — ask for leadership approval on one-time concession

Aditya / Leadership —

Summarizing quickly after Marissa’s notes and Priya's reply: Acme will sign if we (A) accept a redline to the retention clause, and (B) provide a billing-credit/discount limited to the expansion line. Proposed concession: 12% prepay credit on the $250k expansion ARR (one-time credit of $30,000) if PO confirmed by 2028-03-22 and DocuSign executed within 72 hours.

Why approve?
- Preserves Q2 bookings and keeps the account on our platform for the next three years (strategic account + referenceable).
- Financial tradeoff: one-time $30k impact vs. $1.2M+ lifetime value and current OKR need.

We need a leadership sign-off by 5:00pm PT today to finalize the updated quote and send DocuSign to Acme tomorrow morning. If approved, I’ll (1) issue the revised quote, (2) prepare the DocuSign envelope (linked), and (3) coordinate finance to accept the alternate billing code.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
Forecast impact: see consolidated-forecast-03-15-2028.xlsx (Acme tab).

Please reply A (approve) / N (decline) / C (need changes) — short replies only.

—Sean
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Acme procurement — ask for leadership approval on one-time concession

Approved.

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 02:15 PM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Aditya / Leadership —
>
> Summarizing quickly after Marissa’s notes and Priya's reply...

I agree with the mitigation — approve the one-time 12% prepay credit on the expansion line conditional on PO by 2028-03-22 and DocuSign completion in 72 hours. Sean, proceed to issue the revised quote and DocuSign. Marissa, coordinate with Finance to accept the billing code change. Karthik, confirm SLA addendum feasibility for BetaCloud by EOD.

I’ll update the leadership roll-up and include the note on impact to the OKR.

—Aditya
